captions.detailed: A countertop mechanical air fryer featuring a rounded grey steel body, a hollow black basket drawer with a handle, two ribbed control dials, and a small red pilot light. The basket drawer slides forward prismatically from the main housing, while the two upper control dials rotate continuously. A small red release button is integrated into the handle, and a central red power button is on the control panel.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a mechanical air fryer with a hollow heating chamber, a sliding front basket drawer with a handle, a prismatic handle button, two rotating control dials, and a small central power button.
captions.factory: Construct the main housing by extruding a rounded-corner profile and shell-hollowing the interior. Create the basket drawer using a similar shelled box with a front handle plate. Model the control dials and button using cylinder primitives with rotational and prismatic joints, and assemble all components with appropriate color materials.
